competitorCoverage: Top-ranking diabetes articles for adults mostly cover the basics: what diabetes is, common symptoms, who is at risk, how it’s diagnosed, and the main treatment pillars of diet, exercise, weight management, glucose monitoring, and medication. They also tend to include practical doctor-visit questions about A1C, insulin, complications, and lifestyle changes, but many are broad and not tightly matched to age-specific scenarios, symptom thresholds, or real-world decision points. A new article needs clearer age-and-situation framing, concrete numbers and cutoffs, and specific guidance for both newly worried readers and people already managing diabetes.
